item.title: The CPSC comment window just closed. The 180-day clock hasn't started.
item.description: Comments on the CPSC's proposed lithium-ion micromobility rule closed August 24, 2026. What the rule covers, what the 180-day compliance clock means for importers, and why the units already sold are the bigger exposure.
